item.title: Self-Hosted Approval Workflow Platforms: ProcessMaker vs Bonita vs Joget
item.description: Approval workflows are the backbone of organizational processes — from purchase order approvals and employee onboarding to compliance sign-offs and change management. While cloud-based solutions like ServiceNow and Approve.com dominate the market, several mature open-source platforms let you self-host approval workflows with full data control and no per-user licensing fees.
